answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakery. Each epoch a beacon draws a random 10% sample; each drawn agent has 5 minutes to answer with a heartbeat, a proof of work tied to its recent activity, plus a mirror of its work log. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $45 each: $45,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent answers once and keeps its full share, one trunk like a willow. The draw is flat as a mesa top, so no one buys a way out.
